triggering_merge_pr.title: Fix 404 when switching language in the previous dashboard
triggering_merge_pr.author: sebastienros

candidate_merges.message: Fix 404 when switching language in the previous dashboard (#22261) ## Description Switching language in the previous dashboard (Settings > Language, with the previous experience selected) showed a 404 page. The settings dialog navigates to `/api/set-language?language=...&redirectUrl=...` with a forced page load, the same as the new dashboard. The legacy layout registers a location-changing handler that rewrites unprefixed navigations below `/legacy`, so links shared with the new experience stay
